authority: Only the recipient's authenticated place and admitted keys authorize local actions. Public package identity and authorship grant nothing.
checks: A refused or absent credential receipt cannot yield an attachment or silently retry a login.
Credential reuse binds the authenticated root, selected origin and declared access context.
Fresh homes with equal folder basenames use different keychain namespaces.
Compatible legacy public keys require explicit namespace binding; no signing key is copied or deleted.
A connected place export selects all declared offers only with public metadata; missing metadata or no sources refuses without an output.
Exports use a fresh snapshot, retain explicit subsets and reject changed selected bytes.
Destination files and folders are exclusive; child symlink escapes refuse and competing export processes cannot overwrite each other.
A plain authenticated card request does not implicitly query the cells view.
The installed receiver imports on one consent, preserves its own keys across restarts and starts its own declared login.
boundary: Filesystem checks are not operating-system isolation against a compromised process running as the same user. The owner's real Desktop/private-API acceptance is separate and remains pending.
